name: use-comments
title: useComments
description: useComments: the comments block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the comments block (`npx better-supabase add comments`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/comments.
